summary.intent: Plan and execute phase 64 of the GSD workflow for cipher-box, implementing rotation soundness and revocation guarantees (filling four throwing stubs in the rotation engine plus related TDD). The user wanted the full pipeline: plan-phase → execute-phase → ship-phase.
summary.outcome: Phase 64 planning completed successfully after one revision iteration (1 blocker + 2 warnings found and fixed by the checker). Wave 1 of 6 executed fully (plans 64-01, 64-02, 64-03 — 276 tests passing, source typechecks clean). Wave 2 (plan 64-04) was dispatched but the transcript ends before it returns.

repo: Phase 64 fills four throwing stubs in `packages/sdk-core/src/rotation/engine.ts`: `mintFileKeyOnRotate`, `reMintGrantsRootedAt`, `mergeConcurrentChildren`, `verifySubtreeClean`. A fifth stub — `mergeChildren` in `folder/merge.ts` — was also a Phase-64 deliverable discovered during research.

D-02 bug: `sealChildReadKey` at engine.ts L344-350 uses `parentReadKey` (a misnomer — it is actually the child's own pre-rotation key). The correct re-seal must happen out-of-band in `rotateReadFromNode` (the BFS caller) under the parent's NEW `readKey'`, then the parent is published once (batched, D-09).

D-06 bug: `registration.ts L174-175` uses `id: params.nodeId ?? crypto.randomUUID()` and `generation: params.nodeGeneration ?? 0`, silently breaking AAD stability and convergence tests at all 6 `updateFolderMetadataAndPublish` call sites in `client.ts` that omit `nodeId`/`nodeGeneration`.

D-07 two bugs: `completedNodeIds.add` at engine.ts L386 fires before `reMintGrantsRootedAt` at L391 (ordering); the resume guard at L458-462 short-circuits without calling `verifySubtreeClean` (missing frontier rebuild).

`contentRekeyPending` (D-05/lazy re-key) is intentionally deferred to Phase 65 — the Phase-64 CRIT-1 deliverable is only minting `fileKey'` onto the node so `rotateOne`'s `sealNode` re-seals the body under the new key.

Wave 6 (plan 64-08) requires the live local API stack: `docker compose -f docker/docker-compose.yml up -d` (ipfs, postgres, redis on 6380, someguy) plus `pnpm --filter @cipherbox/api dev` on port 3000. Start the API server early — it needs lead time before the sdk-e2e wave runs.
Worktrees are avoided in this monorepo: fresh worktrees have no `node_modules`, causing typecheck/tests to fail or requiring a multi-minute `pnpm i` per agent.

GSD plan-checker requires: (1) `## Open Questions (RESOLVED)` section header plus inline `RESOLVED` markers on each question in RESEARCH.md, and (2) a filled per-task verification map in VALIDATION.md with `nyquist_compliant: true` / `status: final`.

tsup/esbuild silently skips type-checking during builds — only an explicit `tsc --noEmit` (including test files) catches type errors in phase-introduced code. Test files are excluded from `tsconfig.build.json`, so pre-existing test-file type errors are invisible to CI.
The GSD commit helper (`gsd-tools commit`) has a known false-negative: it returns `commit_failed` even on successful commits. Always verify with `git log --oneline -1`.

code.finding: D-02 bug: `sealChildReadKey(readKeyPrime, parentReadKey, ...)` seals under the child's own pre-rotation key due to a legacy `parentReadKey` misnomer. The correct re-seal belongs out-of-band in `rotateReadFromNode` under the parent's NEW `readKey'`.
D-07 ordering bug: `completedNodeIds.add` fires before `reMintGrantsRootedAt` at L391. Must be swapped so the node is only marked complete after grant re-minting succeeds.
D-07 resume bug: resume guard short-circuits without calling `verifySubtreeClean`. Must be replaced with frontier-rebuilding resume that always calls `verifySubtreeClean`.
Stale doc comment 'mark contentRekeyPending' — this marker is intentionally deferred to Phase 65 and should not be added in Phase 64.
D-06: `id: params.nodeId ?? crypto.randomUUID()` and `generation: params.nodeGeneration ?? 0` silently break AAD stability; `nodeId`/`nodeGeneration` must be required fields, not defaulted.

`@ts-expect-error` directive was placed above `await expect(` rather than directly above the `updateFolderMetadataAndPublish({...})` call, making it 'unused' while the real TS2345 fired below. Directives must sit on the line immediately preceding the erroring expression.
`CryptoError` was incorrectly imported from `@cipherbox/core`; it is exported from `@cipherbox/crypto`. The wrong import passed vitest at runtime (toThrow matched any throw) but failed tsc.

workflow: Never run concurrent git operations (background commit + foreground commit simultaneously) — causes `index.lock` races and lint-staged stash-pop conflicts that dump untracked files from old stashes into the working tree.

When lint-staged stash-pop conflicts with an old stash, the fix is: restore the conflicted file from HEAD (`git checkout HEAD -- <file>`), move the dumped untracked garbage aside (not delete — it may be recoverable work), then re-commit on a clean tree.
Run `tsc --noEmit` explicitly (not just `tsup build`) after each wave to catch type errors in test files before they accumulate. tsup/esbuild is a bundler, not a type checker.
Wait for background agent commits to finish before starting the next agent to avoid git index races — the 'no agents running' condition is required for safe sequential commits.

GSD plan-checker iteration 2 resolved all issues in one round — both doc fixes (RESEARCH.md resolved markers, VALIDATION.md per-task map) and a substantive plan fix (64-07 no-double-bump mechanism pinned) handled in a single SendMessage to the existing planner agent rather than spawning a new one.
Start the API dev server before the first wave so it's warm by wave 6; the sdk-e2e suite needs a live stack and `docker compose` alone is not sufficient.

friction: GSD commit helper false-negative (`commit_failed` JSON on success) caused repeated confusion and unnecessary polling/re-verification; must always cross-check with `git log --oneline -1`.

Concurrent git background operations (VALIDATION.md commit + pattern-mapper agent commit) caused an `index.lock` race, resulting in a `lint-staged: could not write index` error on the first commit attempt.

lint-staged stash-pop conflicted with a pre-existing old stash (`stash@{1}: On main: phase 3 planning wip`), dumping untracked directories (`tests/e2e/`, `06.1-webapp-automation-testing/`) into the working tree and putting `STATE.md` into `UU` (unmerged) state mid-wave.
